maps.desc: Comma-separated maps to predict: polarAngle, eccentricity, pRFsize

dataset.desc: Dataset label passed to the deepRetinotopy toolbox

subject_id.desc: Internal subject id used when staging the FreeSurfer input

fast.desc: Fast midthickness generation: yes or no

use_gpu.desc: Pass --nv to Singularity for GPU-accelerated inference

container_version.desc: vnmd/deepretinotopy container tag to pull (default: 1.0.18; use 1.0.19 if your resource has Apptainer >= 1.5.3)

nan_aware_projection.desc: Use NaN-aware barycentric interpolation for surface-to-volume projection (non-finite vertices get zero weight; disable if results look worse than standard prism projection)

polar_angle_benson.desc: Fold polar angle from 0-360° to 0-180° (Benson/neuropythy convention; hemisphere encodes left vs right visual field)

outputs.desc: neuro/prf dataset: NIfTI volumes at root, GIFTI overlays in prf_surfaces/, VTK meshes in surfaces/
